method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: The new connection is a phase-aware input map, not another reconstruction of the old damage predicate. Ordinary spawn writes sessionteam=self.team and sessionstate=playing and refreshes spawntime before later on_player_spawned/insertion work. A redeploy batch merely threads the spawnclient route, whose admission/queue branches mean selection is not proof of a fresh spawn clock. Spectator camera/sessionstate and spectator sessionteam are distinct; should_do_player_damage vetoes only the latter. No explicit candocombat writer is present in the 2,632 frozen GSC/CSC references; its effective producer and original value remain unknown. Insertion holds, begin/teleport flags and HMH doublejump/fallheight branches do not directly write those inputs in the cited spans. Spawn protection is the script elapsed<=cached-ms comparison, checked here only with bit 8; equality counts. Native invulnerability is a separate earlier callback veto, with a visible warzonestaging value-registry chain to enable/disableinvulnerability but unresolved native effects and stacked resets. End_round writes postgame before onendround and the table/server-notify/clientfield end channels. Warzone's later game_ended matchflag pulse does not change that state and therefore does not reopen ordinary admission. Finally, ordinary game-over rejection does not erase the earlier postgame hook: allowed trigger-hurt/crush paths may already call finishplayerdamage as MOD_POST_GAME. All remaining old vetoes/returns are reused unchanged; none of these connections proves HMH runtime behavior or closes the native down-versus-kill decision.

summary.answer: The conditional HMH producer-to-consumer connection is now pinned: init_heal creates the exact enabled/rate/delay-mode/cap fields only when the table is absent; the value setter and gadget write enabled, the gadget builds rate/cap, and healthoverlay consumes them. Stored rate0 selects a default-rate path when enabled, while enabled0 blocks the ordinary rate path. The separate var_44d52546 force branch bypasses that rate block but still follows delay/cap/tick admission. Stored cap0 means use var_66cb03ad, including after exempt damage drains the stored cap to0. Spawn and completion reset only their shown fields; no guaranteed automatic re-enable on revive is established. These are recovered-source conditions, not effective HMH settings or original PS4 behavior. [init-fields, value-writes, gadget-build, rate-consumer, cap-consumer, consumer-delay, consumer-force-write, force-producer, gadget-damage, gadget-spawn, gadget-stop, revive-state, revive-tail]
unknowns: Declared defaults (new_health_model1, health_regen1, delay-control0, preamble dvar0, revive-health source write50) are not confirmed effective HMH values. No producer policy precedence or callback order was selected.

Gadget helper function_820a63e9 may have side effects that affect pending preambles; the direct source reset only emits healing_disabled if heal_end is reached. No cancellation guarantee or observed defect is claimed.

Rates use the exact source arithmetic. Neither weapon.var_4465ef1e units nor fallback role/n_regen inputs, quickrevive multiplier dvar, optional additions or missing rate multiplier are resolved here. A fallback rate of0 can still be changed by the later switch; enabled==0 returns before that switch.
Cap0 is a sentinel, including a cap drained to0. Actual tick ordering and delay after damage remain damage_gate-owned; no resulting healing observation is asserted.

The force producer does not set enabled1 in its cited span. Actual caller selection, normal completion delivery, death/abnormal exit cleanup and cross-spawn force-flag lifetime remain unknown. No automatic restart or recovery was attempted.

h4 saved398/503, all27 health-gadget records were already present in frozen PRIOR-BODIES; the105 unrelated missing records remain missing. Old h4 wording such as time-unit labels and opaque helper status remains unchanged and unreviewed; this report states only its newly pinned source connections.
